items.title: Sandisk, Micron, and SK Hynix Slide 3% as NVIDIA Shake-Up Hits Memory Stocks
items.summary: When the AI industry's biggest name loses its chief executive, the chips that feed it feel the tremor first. Memory makers are sliding while tech climbs, and one of them has a surprisingly low multiple that cuts both ways.

items.title: Why Sandisk Stock Dropped on Thursday
items.summary: Nvidia just lost its CEO, and its stock is falling -- but why is Sandisk stock down, too?

items.title: What Is Going on With Sandisk Stock on Thursday?
items.summary: Sandisk Corp. (NASDAQ:SNDK) stock fell about 5% Thursday as investors reduced exposure to AI-linked hardware names following a major leadership change at NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) and a softer broader market backdrop. The move came as S&P 500 futures fell 0.3%, while NVIDIA stock dropped sharply after the company announced an immediate CEO transition. items.title: Nvidia Sinks 11% on Report Board Will Oust Jensen Huang; Bernstein Downgrades: “We’ve Had Enough”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA stock fell 11% on a report that its board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, and Bernstein, Evercore ISI and William Blair downgraded it. Super Micro Computer, Dell, Sandisk and Astera Labs fell with it, though the news says nothing about AI demand.

items.title: Micron Is Back Above $800 After Its Best Day Since July
items.summary: A memory maker briefly outranked the biggest US bank, but only until the closing bell. One week after a brutal selloff, Micron's rebound faces a test that has nothing to do with a single strong day.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Fall, Techs Tumble As Nvidia Board Mulls Ousting CEO Jensen Huang; CoreWeave Rival Nebius Dives On Results
